name: Cross-body stretch
summary: Pull one straight arm across the chest with the other hand until the back of the shoulder stretches.
setup: Face the phone, bring the working arm across the chest at shoulder height and hug it in with the other forearm. Keep the shoulder down. Hold.
brief: Bring the working arm across the chest at shoulder height and hug it in with the other forearm. Keep that shoulder down and hold.
why: The hand held near the opposite shoulder is visible from the front, so the timer runs while the arm is actually across the body.
tempo: Ease in over 5 s, hold, release.
progression: Pull slightly lower across the chest.
contraindications: Pinching at the front of the shoulder.

faults.label: Shoulder rising
faults.tip: Keep the working shoulder down and back; the stretch belongs behind it.

faults.label: Pulling on the elbow
faults.tip: Hooking the elbow twists the joint; hold above the elbow and draw the arm across.

faults.label: Turning the trunk
faults.tip: The trunk stays square to the phone; only the arm moves.

faults.label: Shoulder riding up
faults.tip: The stretched shoulder must stay down or the stretch goes into the neck.

points.t: Straight, across the chest at shoulder height, hugged in.
